faqs.a:
(a)
In all official matters, officers of the city shall conduct themselves in a manner
               so as not to bring disrespect or disrepute to the office held, or to the city. During
               sessions of the official body officers shall treat their fellow officers, the public
               and city employees with respect. Officers shall refrain from personal attacks on the
               public and their fellow officers and impugning the motives of their fellow officers.
               Violations of this section by councilmembers which occur during sessions of the city
               council may be punishable as follows. An allegation of a violation of this section
               shall be brought to the attention of the presiding officer before the meeting adjourns.
               If an allegation is brought to the attention of the presiding officer, the city council
               shall proceed to determine the matter prior to adjourning. The procedure for hearing
               the matter shall be set forth in the city council rules. A violation of this section
               shall be punishable by an oral reprimand made on the record.
(b)
Upon its own motion, an official body may hear and determine violations of this section.
               The city council may develop procedural rules for the investigation and enforcement
               of violations of this section which shall be binding upon all official bodies.
(Code 1981, § 2-57; Ord. No. 3088, § 2, 6-27-1994)
